# Payment Observation Clause

Relays native events from the embedded Payment Instruction at the configured `instruction` binding. The binding has no default path. The automatic `observe` action accepts an embedded event of type Events/Event and emits Payment Event Received in the containing document. The emitted event records the trigger kind, observer clause key, instruction path and exact BlueId reference of the underlying event.

The source instruction retains the authoritative financial state. Consumers can select which event types to act on and read the current linked instruction for confirmed amounts. The observation maintains no independent payment balance or status.
